sources.title: whisper-large-v2: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-large-v2 is a multilingual automatic speech recognition and speech translation model built by openai that handles audio transcription and translation without fine-tuning. The model is a Transformer-based encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) architecture with 1,550M parameters, trained on 680k hours of labelled speech data via large-scale weak supervision. sources.title: whisper-large-v2 · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: Whisper Whisper is a pre trained model for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation. Trained on 680k hours of labelled data, Whisper models demonstrate a strong ability to generalise to many datasets and domains without the need for fine tuning.
